name: finsona-ai
description: Finsona AI: Enterprise Credit Underwriting Intelligence Platform

scripts.dev:api: node scripts/py.mjs -m watchfiles --filter python --sigint-timeout 2 --sigkill-timeout 2 app.devserver.run app
scripts.start: npm run build && node scripts/py.mjs -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.start:lan: npm run build && node scripts/py.mjs -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.demo:reset: node scripts/py.mjs -c "from app.demo import reset; print(reset())"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.gen:api: node scripts/py.mjs -m app.export_openapi && npm --prefix frontend run gen:api
